verdict.rationale: Ramp's first-party developer docs include a dedicated webhooks guide. It says webhooks 'push notifications to your specified endpoint whenever an event happens' as a real-time alternative to polling, and the llms.txt index recommends webhooks for event triggers. These are registrable outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence consists of short excerpts only, so registration mechanics, event types and payload security are not shown. Missing for 10: documented event-type catalog, subscription/registration API or UI details, signature verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
